dedupe_keys.name: how europe s grid operators are preparing for the energy transition snapshot of 32 transmission system operators in 28 countries beyond fossil fuels 2025

description: This case study is a May 2025 campaign report by Beyond Fossil Fuels, a snapshot of how 32 electricity transmission system operators (TSOs) in 28 European countries prepare, or fail to prepare, for a renewables-based electricity system. The landing page summarises that most TSOs still plan on outdated national energy scenarios and targets, so grid connection queues are ballooning, clean electricity is curtailed and investment in flexibility lags. Key findings listed are 1,700 GW of renewable projects in connection queues across 16 countries, EUR 7.2 billion of renewable electricity curtailed in seven countries in 2024, only five TSOs considering scenarios with coal and fossil gas replaced by renewables by 2035, 11 of 34 TSOs under the minimum form of legal ownership unbundling, and few regulators with climate neutrality in their responsibilities. The report adds that combining the best practices across TSOs would make a near-perfect model and points to weak oversight and transparency. Access: landing page and report download, free. Caveats: an advocacy organisation's assessment, and the report itself was not opened. It suits policy evaluation and grid planning studies, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
